-- Batch add tags for 2023 projects

-- A Christmas Carol
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'A Christmas Carol' AND t.name IN ('Holiday Theatre', '2023', 'Family Show', 'Charles Dickens', 'Victorian Era', 'Regional Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Elf the Musical  
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Elf the Musical' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2023', 'Holiday Theatre', 'Family Musical', 'Christmas', 'Comedy')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Kinky Boots
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Kinky Boots' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2023', 'LGBTQ+ Themes', 'Contemporary', 'Drag', 'Acceptance')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
